Maya Patel: quick follow-up from the all-hands — can someone drop the RCA link here and call out the concrete next steps? cc @Chris Liao :eyes:
Omar Rivera: RCA here: https://internal.redwood.ai/rcas/2026-03-18-incident-summary — the main causal chain is described in section 2.2. TL;DR: autoscaler misconfig + unseen model variant spike.
Maya Patel: thanks Omar. two quick Qs: 1) who owns the rollback/playbook updates? 2) what's the deployment gating to avoid variant spikes?
Chris Liao: owning this. I put an action list below. high level: improve autoscaler thresholds + add a soft quota for model-variant fallbacks.
incident-bot: [Automated] RCA doc uploaded by Omar Rivera: https://internal.redwood.ai/rcas/2026-03-18-incident-summary :page_facing_up:
Sophia Nguyen: can we get the runbook link too? current runbook still references old autoscaling heuristics.
Omar Rivera: runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/serve/autoscaler-v2.md — needs updating, flagged lines 45-62.
Ana Torres: FYI I pulled logs for the spike window and added a short note to the RCA about client pattern causing bursty prefixes.
Elena Park: for rollout gating, proposal: add a traffic shadowing stage + a 5% canary for new model variants for 24h, then automatic 25% after health check.
Chris Liao: agree with Elena. Action items (owners + rough ETA):
- CH1: Update autoscaler thresholds & add soft quota fallback (owner: @Sophia Nguyen, ETA: Tue EOD).
- CH2: Update runbook with spike detection + triage steps (owner: @Omar Rivera, ETA: Wed).
- CH3: Implement shadowing + canary stage for model variant rollouts (owner: @Elena Park + eng-platform, ETA: next sprint).
- CH4: Postmortem note + customer comms draft (owner: @Ana Torres, ETA: Mon morning).
Chris Liao: I've added these to the reliability board and assigned tickets; ping me if you don't see assignments.
Maya Patel: can you paste the ticket links? makes follow-up easier.
Omar Rivera: tickets: https://phab.redwood.ai/T12345 https://phab.redwood.ai/T12346 https://phab.redwood.ai/T12347
Sophia Nguyen: adding a quick checklist to T12345 for runbook verification steps.
Ana Torres: I'll draft a short customer-facing post and share in #support for review.
Elena Park: note re: infra cost — shadowing + canary adds small overhead; ops to estimate cost impact before rollout.
Chris Liao: ops, can you estimate by EOD tomorrow? @ops-team
Maya Patel: thanks all. last ask: can we have a short one-pager for leadership that summarizes risk delta if we delay CH1 by 2 weeks? — need it for the executive follow-up.
Chris Liao: will prepare and send by tomorrow noon.
Omar Rivera: adding links in the RCA to the tickets and runbook sections I edited.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup: marking this as done from all-hands follow-up POV. please update thread when owners close items.
Sophia Nguyen: will update T12345 once runbook changes are merged.
incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up check-in scheduled on board T12345 in 7 days.
